steps.data: Restore: remove project grant, delete approval team, clear billing email, terminate disposable contract; time and draft invoice retained

chapters.title: Before you start: customer prepares a disposable shared ticket and shared task
1. Persist one commercial entry (QA, native shared ticket, Add Time Entry)
2. Native stopwatch on the shared ticket: start, stop, one entry
2. Customer effort: native customer ticket offers no time entry; operational entry on the shared task
3. Follow the entries into the native timesheet, submit and approve
4. Reconcile commercial billing: Automatic Invoices preview and draft
Restore: remove project grant, delete approval team, clear billing email, terminate disposable contract; time and draft invoice retained

limitations: Approver is the same QA user (no separate MSP approver identity was provided; Glinda excluded by the brief).
Customer native ticket (AlgaDesk workspace) offers no time-entry flow, so the customer operational entry and combined-effort comparison use a disposable shared project task on the same relationship.
Draft invoice only; nothing finalized or emailed.
Approving the QA sheet also approves every other QA entry in that period, including one guide-06 entry (705281b3, unresolved, not invoiced here).

Earlier failed attempts run-a/run-b/run-c left approved commercial entries on the same contract line; the draft carries them too and reconciles against all approved contract-line entries on the sheet.
